csv_project_name: Design for Montbello Branch Library Renovation
csv_scope_of_work: The Denver Bond Office ( DBO ) and the Department of Transportation & Infrastructure ( DOTI ), City and County of Denver ( City ), has issued a Request for Qualifications (the RFQ ) for Architectural and Engineering Professional Design Services for the Blair Caldwell African American Research Library & Museum Renovation, Montbello Branch Library Renovation, and Montbello Civic Center Park Shade Structure Projects. The City and County of Denver (City) is soliciting Requests for Qualifications for Design Teams to provide Architectural and Engineering Professional Services for the Blair-Caldwell African American Research Library Renovation located at 2401 Welton Street, the Montbello Branch Library Renovation located at 12955 Albrook Drive, and for the Montbello Shade Structure Plaza located in the Montbello Civic Center Park at 4401 Crown Boulevard.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Programming, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Electrical Engineering, Fire Protection Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Utility Engineering

title: Design Services for Montbello Branch Library Renovation
short_description: Design services for two library renovations and a civic park shade structure in Denver.
project_scope: RFQ for architectural and engineering design services for three bond-funded projects in Denver: renovation of the Blair-Caldwell African American Research Library & Museum at 2401 Welton Street, renovation of the Montbello Branch Library at 12955 Albrook Drive, and design of the Montbello Shade Structure Plaza at Montbello Civic Center Park, 4401 Crown Boulevard. Total stated construction cost for the combined program is 10.9 million USD. No gross floor areas, spans, or detailed technical dimensions are provided.
services: Architectural and engineering professional design services, including architecture, interior design/space planning, programming, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, environmental engineering/planning/design, electrical engineering, fire protection engineering, mechanical engineering, structural engineering, and utility engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Includes structural engineering within a multidisciplinary design team.
- Contains a shade structure component, which may involve architecturally expressive lightweight structural design.
- Library renovations are building projects of some interest, but no major spans or complex structural requirements are described.
- Procurement is primarily architecture-led and bundled with many disciplines, reducing direct structural focus.
- Total construction budget is moderate, suggesting limited structural scope compared with sbp's core high-priority projects.

fee_explanation: No explicit design fee or structural engineering fee is stated in the source.
references_qualifications: RFQ seeks qualified design teams for architectural and engineering professional services across multiple disciplines. Specific minimum reference counts or qualification thresholds are not stated in the source excerpt.
